title: cEDH Workshop
details: Join us for a laid-back cEDH hangout night built around the competitive side of Magic: The Gathering. This isn’t a tournament—there is no pressure. It’s simply a space to jam high-powered games, try out new decks, test fresh tech, and get real reps in with your favorite lists. Whether you’re tuning a new brew or sharpening your main deck, this is the perfect environment to play, learn, and hang out with other competitive-minded players. Bring your best, keep it friendly, and let’s enjoy some great games together.

title: Commander Nite!!
details: Join us for Commander Night and enjoy a fun, casual evening of Magic: The Gathering! Entry is $5. Bring your favorite Commander deck, meet up with friends, and play in a relaxed, welcoming environment. At the end of the night, we’ll raffle off prizes to participants — everyone has a chance to win! Come hang out, sling some spells, and enjoy the game.

title: Commanderfest!
details: Commanderfest is here every Saturday at 2:30 PM for an epic afternoon of Magic: The Gathering Commander! Entry is $8. Bring your favorite deck and enjoy a fun, social Commander experience with plenty of big plays and wild moments. At the end of the night, we’re giving away a guaranteed booster box to one lucky participant! Great games, great vibes, and big prizes — don’t miss it!

title: Casual Commander Wednesdays
details: Join us every Wednesday for casual Magic: The Gathering Commander play at Honey Pot Meadery. Bring your favorite Commander deck, grab a pour, and find a pod for a relaxed night of multiplayer Magic. This is a casual open-play night, not a league or tournament, so players are welcome to drop in, meet the community, and play at their own pace. Newer players, returning players, and experienced Commander players are all welcome. When: Wednesdays Time: Main group arrives around 7:00 PM Format: Casual Commander Entry: Free to play Location: Honey Pot Meadery Bring: A Commander deck Loaner supplies: Precon decks, playmats, dice, and tokens available to borrow
